title: Mother and Toddler with Pet Dog on Lawn, 1950s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: He has an old pipe of Jacks in his hand. Rags is scratching Stan who is in the house, thinks we want a chair He treats us like like a kid.
description: A sweet domestic candid snapshot from around 1950 showing a young mother sitting cross-legged on a grass lawn holding her toddler son in her lap. The boy holds an old smoking pipe belonging to 'Jack.' To the left, their family dog, named 'Rags,' is captured mid-motion scratching itself. A child's wagon/walker toy rests on the grass in the background near garden bushes.
